question: Iron and steel are ______ industries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**mineral based.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iron and steel industries** are **mineral-based industries**.

 
 
• Iron and steel are manufactured using **minerals **such as **iron ore**, **coal**, and **limestone**.
 
• These minerals are extracted from mines and processed to produce iron and steel.
 
• This industry is considered a **part of the heavy industry sector**, which relies heavily on mineral resources.
 
• The mineral-based nature of the iron and steel industry is reflected in its supply chain, which includes mining, transportation, and processing of minerals.
 
 
 
• **Mineral-based industries **are generally **capital-intensive **and **require large investments** in equipment and infrastructure.
 
 
• This industry **includes mining**, **processing**, and **refining **of minerals such as coal, oil, gas, and metals.
 
• It is **a critical sector for industrial development and energy production.**
 
• Some other examples of mineral based industries:
 
 
• Copper smelting industry
 
• Aluminium industry
 
• Lead and zinc smelting industry
 
• Cement industry 
 
• Fertiliser industry 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Handloom** is a **type of textile industry** that produces woven fabrics using hand-operated looms.

 
 
• It is a **labor-intensive industry** that relies on traditional techniques and skills.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture-based industries** include **food processing**, **dairy**, and **animal husbandry.**
 
 
• These industries **use agricultural products as raw materials** and involve processing, packaging, and distribution of the final products.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture **is a primary sector that **involves cultivation of crops and livestock.**
 
 
• It is a vital sector for food security and rural development.
